name: Steward
$comment: Pipeline supervision for a long-running Paseo-orchestrated project: reads control/COMMAND.md, control/MERGES.md, control/WAVES.md, output/status-one-pager.md, runs/ledger.jsonl and the solver fork state, then shows lease, slot occupancy, blocked legs and the owner's batched questions. Its own tick dispatches the steward into ONE configured workspace, because `paseo schedule` creates a new workspace per run. No network access of its own.
description: One steward per project: dispatches legs into per-leg worktrees, verifies each with a deterministic gate, and accepts only artifacts that carry provenance. Auto-accept decides the verdict on work already dispatched; lazy mode also plans.
